summary: After several failed attempts at hidden process management on Windows that produced unwanted console windows, the agent fell back to simple `nohup` backgrounding of the pnpm dev processes. The agent-server (`@gizmo/agent-server`) was started separately with `pnpm --filter @gizmo/agent-server start` and is now listening on `127.0.0.1:8787`, while the app (vite) listens on `localhost:5173`.
decisions: Use `nohup ... < /dev/null &` to background pnpm dev processes on Windows rather than custom detached runners, because custom approaches kept producing visible console windows.
errors: agent-server (`tsx watch src/server.ts`) repeatedly failed to bind to port 8787 inside the pnpm `--parallel` dev script, causing vite to log `ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:8787` ws proxy errors and pnpm to exit with `ERR_PNPM_RECURSIVE_RUN_FIRST_FAIL` exit status 3221225786.
